SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Darnell Williams
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0109 | darnell.williams@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Data analyst with ten years of experience, the last seven in customer analytics at an electric utility serving about 900,000 accounts. Writes Oracle SQL and Python daily, maintains the Tableau reporting for outages and billing, and worked on a customer data cleanup of account, premise and meter records. Comfortable explaining odd numbers to call center, billing and field operations leaders.

EXPERIENCE
Data Analyst, Customer Analytics | Ravenbrook Electric Company, Columbus, OH | Nov 2019 to Present
• Maintain 14 Tableau dashboards on outage minutes, restoration times, billing exceptions and payment arrangements, refreshed daily from the Oracle customer information system.
• Wrote matching queries for a nine month customer data cleanup run by IT and billing, producing weekly lists of likely duplicate accounts and bad service addresses for the billing team to review.
• Wrote Python jobs that pull outage management system extracts every 15 minutes during storms and post estimated restoration counts for the communications team.
• Pulled weekly enrollment counts for a 2023 paperless billing incentive pilot and passed the counts to the program manager, who wrote the results summary.
• Built the monthly high bill complaint report, using SQL window functions to compare each account against its own prior 12 months and weather adjusted usage.
• Send meter operations a monthly smart meter read failure report that ranks routes by missed reads.
• Built a SQL reconciliation between the billing system and the general ledger that flags revenue posting gaps within a day instead of at month end.
• Answer ad hoc requests from rates, regulatory and customer service teams, often the same day.
• Keep a shared log of recurring billing exception types so call center supervisors can see which ones are rising from week to week.
• Join the weekly storm readiness call during severe weather season to confirm the outage extract jobs are running and the restoration counts look reasonable.

Billing Operations Analyst | Pinecrest Telecom Services, Columbus, OH | Jul 2016 to Oct 2019
• Reconciled monthly billing runs for 180,000 residential and small business accounts and investigated variances above $5,000.
• Built Excel and Access reports on billing adjustments and credits by reason code for the billing manager's weekly review.
• Learned SQL on the job and moved six recurring reports from manual exports to scheduled queries.
• Flagged a rate table setup error affecting a small group of accounts for the billing manager.
• Wrote the desk procedures for month end billing close that the team still uses.
• Answered billing representative questions about unusual credits and pulled account histories when a customer disputed an adjustment.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2016

SKILLS
Data: Oracle SQL, PL/SQL basics, Snowflake (current migration project), Microsoft Access
Programming: Python (pandas, requests, cx_Oracle, scheduled jobs), Git
Visualization: Tableau (Desktop, Prep, Server), Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, VBA macros)
Domain: customer information systems, outage management, billing reconciliation, data quality rules and monitoring
Communication: written incident summaries, monthly operations reviews with directors

ADDITIONAL
• Tableau Certified Data Analyst, 2023
• Completed a Snowflake fundamentals course in 2025 ahead of the warehouse migration
• Volunteer at a public library tech help desk, two Saturdays a month

ASSISTANT:
{"score": 75, "decision": "ADVANCE", "reason": "Darnell is a local candidate with strong SQL, Python, Tableau, and data quality experience, holding a B.S. in Statistics from OSU."}
